objective: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

description: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this Syndicate. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
More important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
Now go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.
completion: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
This will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
